answer: Collect five juror signatures, escrow the payout, and release it only after finality. Compare each verdict against the quorum median: a juror that diverges by two bands loses its stake, and the panel is slashed when the spread itself is the anomaly. The delta between two identical submissions from one operator is the signal, not the absolute score. At dawn a farm can post a spiral of accounts that vote in unison, but escrow plus slash sets the price, and every fake vote costs a ferrous stake larger than the honest work it approves.
